newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar adjusts after earlier trade buys.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar adjusts after earlier trade buys.

text.p: Nearby white sugar futures drifted back to unchanged as commission spread dealings set the tone after an initial bout of trade buying, market sources said on Friday.

One trade player bid market prices higher at the start of the session and then tried to sell for a quick profit, after which commission house interest was seen in at least three different spreads, they said.
"The buying has gradually crept back so we're effectively back to unchanged," said one.
At 1120 GMT most positions werre slightly weaker, with spot August down 70 cents at $310.00 and October down 40 cents at $300.90. Volume reached 450 lots.

Traders said August/October was narrowing to around $8.50 but noted that the main focus of interest would be in New York's July contract as players adjusted positions after this week's heavy May delivery.
Selling interest in the August/July arbitrage was expected at around $72 and above, they said.
In Paris trading was confined to just 73 lots of the nearby August contract, down $2.00 at $310.00.
